notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
We've made two small adjustments to Stig:

 Skipping a level no longer marks that level as completed. You can continue forward, but your game progress will not be affected, and no achievements will be gained.
 There is now an animation playing if you attempt to push something that cannot be moved.


Wishing you happy holidays!
Miriam & Lage

notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.notes:
The first update to Stig is here! We have fixed various small issues and bugs, and added two new features to the game:


 Stuck? There's now a possibility to skip levels from the pause menu
 Do you want to start over? There are now multiple save profiles and a reset progress button
